findings.boundary_basis: The 2018-2019 down-cycle was public decision-time history encodable as a downside distribution — the case should have carried it.
evidence: Internal situation cites the 2018-2019 down-cycle (revenue -10.0%/-1.3%) as history, but no variable in the case can reproduce it.
All growth distributions are non-negative at the low end (base_growth low 0.0, revenue_growth low 0.05), so the downside tail is structurally absent.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a downside_shock variable (e.g. NEV subsidy taper or auto-market contraction) with a negative coupling to revenue_growth, or record explicitly that the case is growth-only by design.
findings.summary: No variable represents a demand downturn or subsidy withdrawal; the growth-only structure cannot produce a loss.
